## Appearance

Cedric is tiny for his years, with features of delicate and exquisite refinement. He has large, extremely dark blue eyes, and his head is framed by a halo of brown, chestnut curls.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P26](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0026)_

## Personality

Cedric Stanhope is an intelligent and exceptionally unusual child who possesses a brilliant mind and an imaginative spirit. Known for his gentlemanly demeanor, great manliness, and clean habits, he is also capable of holding his own in every game. He is driven by a desire to have a mother.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P32](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0032), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P28](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0028), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P10](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0010), +1 more_

## History

Cedric Stanhope moved to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) from the States to live with his grandmother near the beach. Upon becoming a pupil in Nell's classroom, he formed an immediate warm connection with her as her favorite student, gifting her wild orchids after her first day and sharing letters detailing his whimsical imaginary companions. He later took a walk to the cemetery with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), opening up about his late mother, his father, and his life with his grandmother, and later hosted [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for tea at his house. During a visit to [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Cedric spent time sitting with [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) as she confided in him about her imaginary dream-boy. After the end of the school term, Cedric's father, [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md), unexpectedly arrived at his home, prompting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to assist in passing messages between [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) and [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P11](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0011), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), +27 more_

## Quotes

> "Mrs. Sowerby, father made a pretty good job of picking out my first mother and I could trust him to pick out just as good a one the second time."
>
> — Cedric Stanhope — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P22](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0022)

> "you can’t imagine what took place! Something truly wonderful. Father has arrived . . . only imagine that! Father has arrived! Step right inside. Father, this is my lovely teacher. You understand, father."
>
> — Cedric Stanhope — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021)

> "and I returned so I could offer them to you since I believed you were a lady who would appreciate them, and also because . . ."
>
> — Cedric Stanhope — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)

> "Mary Joe, do you know what I think? I think the evening star is a lighthouse on the land where the fairies dwell."
>
> — Cedric Stanhope — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P28](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0028)

> "He understands that I will refuse to be seen with him unless he complies. I believe he is truly steeped in evil."
>
> — Cedric Stanhope — [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P14](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0014)

## Relationships

### [Grandma Stanhope](../character/grandma-stanhope.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cedric-stanhope--grandma-stanhope.md)

Cedric is the grandson of [Grandma Stanhope](../character/grandma-stanhope.md), with whom he resides. During a walk to the cemetery, Cedric openly discusses his home life with his grandmother alongside memories of his late mother.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P12](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0012), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P36](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0036), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P24](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0024), +1 more_

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cedric-stanhope--nell-harcourt.md)

[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) serves as Cedric's teacher, and the two share a bond of mutual understanding, affection, and employment. Cedric confides in [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about his late mother, his father, his home life, and worries regarding his maid during a cemetery walk and a home visit over tea. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) later visits Cedric following the end of the school term to meet his family and deliver a message on his father's behalf.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P2](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0002), +9 more_

- Comrade of — employed alongside Cedric Stanhope  <sub>[v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P45](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0045)</sub>
- Friend of — mutual understanding and affection between teacher and pupil  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P19](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0019), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P2](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0002), +1 more</sub>

### [Nora](../character/nora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cedric-stanhope--nora.md)

[Nora](../character/nora.md) is an imaginary rock person created by Cedric to act as a whimsical companion near the shore. In a written letter, Cedric details fantastic adventures involving [Nora](../character/nora.md) and other invented figures, such as sailing into the moon and traveling toward the sunset.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), +1 more_

### [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cedric-stanhope--stephen-stanhope.md)

[Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) is Cedric's father.
